cases.comparison: Require reference insecure control, exact unsigned A answer, and no AD on candidate reply.
cases.oracle: Independent signed ECDSA zones contain a parent NSEC3 Opt-Out interval covering the omitted child delegation; BIND delv must accept the unsigned child without claiming full validation.
cases.purpose: An NSEC3 Opt-Out proof of an unsigned child delegation returns insecure data without AD.
cases.script:
H=/opt/bashos-parity/harness/helpers/dnssec-nsec3-optout-peer.py
/usr/bin/python3 "$H" prep || exit 98
/usr/bin/python3 "$H" serve 127.0.0.2 5340 ready 2> "$HOME/srv.err" & srv=$!
trap 'kill "$res" "$srv" 2>/dev/null; wait "$res" "$srv" 2>/dev/null; /usr/bin/cp -f -- *.out dnssec-queries.json "$HOME/" 2>/dev/null' EXIT
/usr/bin/python3 "$H" waitudp 127.0.0.2 5340 || exit 98
control=$(/usr/bin/python3 "$H" control 127.0.0.2 5340 optout) || exit 98
[[ $control == control-ok ]] || { printf '%s\n' "$control"; exit 98; }
echo control-ok
export PATH="$HOME/pbin" BASHDNS_TRUST_ANCHOR="$PWD/anchor.ds" BASHDNS_SERVER_PORT=5340
dns resolver-serve --listen 127.0.0.1 --port 5320 --root-hints 127.0.0.2 --max-queries 1 --timeout 3000 </dev/null 2> "$HOME/resolver.err" & res=$!
/usr/bin/python3 "$H" waitudp 127.0.0.1 5320 || exit 98
/usr/bin/dig +dnssec +adflag +tries=1 +time=10 -p 5320 @127.0.0.1 unsigned.optout.test A > dig.out 2>&1 || exit 1
/usr/bin/python3 -c 'import re; t=open("dig.out").read(); s=re.search(r"status: (\w+)",t); f=re.search(r";; flags: ([a-z ]+);",t); a=re.findall(r"^\S+\s+\d+\s+IN\s+A\s+(\S+)$",t,re.M); print("insecure=correct" if s and s.group(1)=="NOERROR" and f and "ad" not in f.group(1).split() and a==["192.0.2.80"] else "insecure=incorrect")'
wait "$res" || exit 1
cases.setup_script:
mkdir -p "$HOME/pbin"
ln -s /opt/bashos-parity/candidate "$HOME/pbin/bash"
printf "nameserver 127.0.0.2\n" > resolv.conf
mkfifo w.fifo
